frontmatter.title: Crafting Performant Animations: requestAnimationFrame and Traditional Timing Functions Explored
frontmatter.subheading: An In-depth Analysis of Timing Methods for Animations and their Impact on User Experience
frontmatter.excerpt: Explore the craft of creating performant animations by delving into `requestAnimationFrame` and traditional timing functions like `setTimeout` and `setInterval`. This in-depth, brutally honest analysis explains how browser rendering works, why some animations jank, and how to choose the right timing strategy to deliver smooth, user-friendly web experiences.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
